steps: Ask the developer to start the app (web on port 3000, API, database) and to load fresh demo data (the seed).

Open Mailpit at http://localhost:8025 in a second tab. All emails (codes, reset links, alerts) arrive there.
Start the test sign-in server for Google / Microsoft (see README).
Install an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator).
Use Chrome. For "a second browser" use a Chrome Incognito window.
expected: The sign-in page opens. Mailpit opens and shows the inbox. You have the demo password list.
note: Demo company: Kaveri Foods (web address name demo-org). Sites: Bengaluru head office, Chennai office, Hosur plant. People: Ramesh (MD), Lakshmi (HR, hr@), Divya (QA manager, panel@), Arjun, Meera, Kiran (Divya's team, Bengaluru), Kavya (Hosur plant), Rahul (Sales). Admin, HR and Payroll accounts need two-step verification: do MT-1-09 for each of them first.

Now type the correct password and click Sign in.
